verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's own hosted MCP server documents a Create-Dashboard tool that builds dashboards with text cards and reports, so dashboards can be created programmatically through a first-party interface. However, that is an AI-assistant MCP tool rather than a documented REST management API. The Query API only reads report results and cannot create or manage them. Missing for 10: a documented REST/HTTP endpoint for dashboard CRUD, programmatic create/update/delete of saved insights/reports, dashboard update/delete operations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
